description: This file defines a UserEntity class implementing OAuth2 server's UserEntityInterface. It represents a user entity with an identifier, including methods for construction and creation from a User entity.

classes.name: UserEntity
classes.description: A class implementing OAuth2 UserEntityInterface, representing a user with an identifier, capable of being created from a User entity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the user entity with a given identifier.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the user.

methods.name: createFromEntity
methods.description: Factory method to create a UserEntity instance from an existing User entity.
